cards.prompt: What three essay-writing methods were compared in the MIT study 'Your Brain on ChatGPT'?
Order groups from strongest to weakest neural connectivity.
cards.answer: Brain-only strongest, search engine moderate, LLM-assisted weakest.

cards.prompt: The more cognitive load used when learning, the worse we recall what we learned.
cards.answer: Myth: more cognitive load in learning leads to better recall.

cards.prompt: A student has an LLM write all their essay drafts to save time. What does the study suggest about their learning?
cards.answer: Less cognitive effort and weaker neural connectivity, so recall is likely worse than writing by themselves.

cards.prompt: The group that exhibited the weakest neural connection was the ____ group.
